responsibility: Declares the shared Arm/AArch64 backend interfaces provided by the common support layer. It exposes scheduler dependency predicates, RTL pattern recognizers such as REV16 matching, memory-model helpers, BTI/PAC query and generation routines, inline-asm adjustment support, branch-protection option parsing/validation entry points, and the shared cost-table structure definitions used by target tuning code to describe ALU, multiply, memory, floating-point, and vector instruction costs.
